query: Create a 7-day Egypt trip focusing on history.
answer:
Here’s a thrilling **7-day Egypt itinerary** focused on history, taking you through Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, and Alexandria. Each day is packed with historical sites that will immerse you in the rich cultural tapestry of this incredible country!

---

### **Day 1 — Cairo: Ancient Civilizations**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **The Egyptian Museum** — 2 hours — Explore the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts, including treasures from Tutankhamun’s tomb. Arrive early to avoid crowds. **Ticket price: 200 EGP**.  
![The Egyptian Museum](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/the-egyptian-museum-0-1781614373.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Felfela Restaurant** — Enjoy traditional Egyptian dishes like koshari and falafel, located near Tahrir Square.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC)** — 1.5 hours — Discover over 50,000 artifacts and the Royal Mummies Hall. **Ticket price: 200 EGP**.  
![NMEC](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/national-museum-of-egyptian-civilization-nmec-0-1781568424.jpg)

• **Al-Hussein Mosque** — 1 hour — Visit this holy 19th-century mosque in Khan el-Khalili, reputed burial place of Imam Hussein's head. Entry is free.  
![Al-Hussein Mosque](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/5f/Al-Hussein_Mosque.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Khan el-Khalili Bazaar** — Explore the vibrant market filled with spices, textiles, and souvenirs. Perfect for soaking in local culture.

---

### **Day 2 — Giza: The Pyramids**

**Morning (8:00–12:00)**
• **Great Pyramids of Giza** — 3 hours — Visit the iconic pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Don't miss the Great Sphinx! **Ticket price: 200 EGP**.  
![Pyramids](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/01/Great_Pyramids_of_Giza.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Restaurant** — Enjoy some grilled meats and salads with a view of the pyramids.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Solar Boat Museum** — 1 hour — Discover the reconstructed solar boat of Pharaoh Khufu, found at the base of the Great Pyramid. **Ticket price: 100 EGP**.  
![Solar Boat Museum](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/5f/Solar_Boat_Museum.jpg)

• **Sphinx** — 1 hour — Take in the majestic Sphinx, a symbol of ancient Egypt.

**Evening**
• **Sound and Light Show at the Pyramids** — Experience the history of Egypt narrated against the backdrop of the illuminated pyramids.

---

### **Day 3 — Luxor: The Valley of the Kings**

**Morning (8:00–12:00)**
• **Valley of the Kings** — 3 hours — Discover the tombs of ancient pharaohs, including that of Tutankhamun. **Ticket price: 240 EGP**.  
![Valley of the Kings](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e7/Valley_of_the_Kings_01.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Restaurant** — Try traditional dishes like grilled meats and koshari.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Temple of Karnak** — 2 hours — Visit this vast temple complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world. Enjoy the magnificent pillars and obelisks.  
![Temple of Karnak](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/76/Karnak_Temple%2C_Luxor.jpg)

• **Luxor Museum** — 1 hour — Explore artifacts from the Theban temples and necropolis. **Ticket price: 140 EGP**.  
![Luxor Museum](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f5/Luxor_Museum.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Luxor Corniche** — Stroll along the beautiful waterfront promenade with cafes and stunning views of the Nile.

---

### **Day 4 — Aswan: Nubian Heritage**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Temple of Philae** — 2 hours — Visit this beautiful temple dedicated to the goddess Isis, located on an island. **Ticket price: 100 EGP**.  
![Temple of Philae](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0d/Temple_of_Philae.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Nubian Restaurant** — Try traditional Nubian dishes while enjoying views of the Nile.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Tombs of the Nobles** — 2 hours — Explore the rock-cut tombs on the west bank hillside with panoramic Aswan views. **Ticket price: 100 EGP**.  
![Tombs of the Nobles](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e7/Tombs_of_the_Nobles.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Nile Felucca Ride** — Experience a serene sunset on a felucca boat on the Nile.

---

### **Day 5 — Abu Simbel Adventure**

**Early Morning (5:00–9:00)**
• **Abu Simbel Temples** — 3 hours (including travel) — Take an early morning trip to see the magnificent temples of Ramses II and Nefertari. **Ticket price: 420 EGP**.  
![Abu Simbel](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/88/Vue_de_la_Fortresse_d%27Ibrym.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Lunch at Local Restaurant** — Enjoy a meal in Abu Simbel with local flavors.

**Afternoon (13:00–15:00)**
• **Return to Aswan** — Relax and enjoy the views along the way.

**Evening**
• **Dinner at a Local Restaurant** — Savor traditional dishes and reflect on your day's adventures.

---

### **Day 6 — Alexandria: Hellenistic Heritage**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa** — 2 hours — Explore this underground wonder blending Pharaonic and Greco-Roman styles. **Ticket price: 80 EGP**.  
![Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/72/Catacombs_of_Kom_El_Shoqafa.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Seafood Restaurant** — Enjoy fresh seafood along the Mediterranean coast.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Qaitbay Citadel** — 1.5 hours — Visit this 15th-century fortress on the site of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria. **Ticket price: 60 EGP**.  
![Qaitbay Citadel](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/bb/Qaitbay_Citadel.jpg)

• **Bibliotheca Alexandrina** — 1.5 hours — Discover the modern library built to commemorate the ancient Library of Alexandria.  
![Bibliotheca Alexandrina](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/bf/Bibliotheca_Alexandrina.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Stroll along the Corniche** — Enjoy the sea breeze and views of the Mediterranean.

---

### **Day 7 — Return to Cairo and Cultural Immersion**

**Morning (9:00–12:00)**
• **Coptic Cairo** — Visit ancient churches like the Hanging Church and Ben Ezra Synagogue. Entry is generally free, but donations are appreciated.  
![Coptic Cairo](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6c/Hanging_Church.jpg)

**Lunch**
• **Local Café** — Try traditional Egyptian breakfast dishes.

**Afternoon (13:00–16:00)**
• **Islamic Cairo** — Explore historical mosques like Al-Azhar Mosque and Sultan Hassan Mosque. Entry is usually free.  
![Al-Azhar Mosque](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/9a/Al-Azhar_Mosque.jpg)

**Evening**
• **Dinner at a Local Restaurant** — Celebrate your last night with a mix of Egyptian dishes, perhaps in a traditional setting with music.

---

### **Travel Tips**
- Wear comfortable shoes for walking at the sites.
- Stay hydrated and carry water, especially in the heat.
- Consider hiring local guides for deeper insights and history.
- Plan for early mornings, especially for trips like Abu Simbel.
